about: Stored digests of the recurrent fits (rnn_fit, the tape backward) at the speed harness's large shape: tools/sequence_speed.py --algos lstm,gru,rnn --expect sequence/checks/rnn_fit_digests.json, HIGGS 1M rows, MOJOLEARN_NUMERIC_MODE=identical. Recorded from the pass-6 race (integration fda883af2, default build): NVIDIA L40S and AMD MI325X gave the same digests. The deleted hand backward (MOJOLEARN_AUTOGRAD_RNN_OFF) gave the same bits as the tape in every pass-5 build (nv-04, amd-08). A digest moves only with a declared bit version; then re-record this file from one run on each vendor.
